thread:
laura: Heads up — Acme retest window confirmed for next week, need to finalize access, evidence handoff, and RBAC changes by EOD today.
nate: Thanks. Can you paste the list of resources they need? bucket names, KMS keys, and any DB read-only roles?
jess: We gave them read-only on staging-logs and temporary get/list on s3://acme-pt-evidence. KMS unwrap access is the sticky bit.
laura: Right. Tom (redteam) asked for access to decrypt sample log blobs to verify telemetry. We discussed ephemeral KMS roles rather than sharing key material.
laura: @tom-redteam can you confirm the exact KMS operations you need? decrypt only, or GenerateDataKey as well?
tom-redteam: decrypt only for evidence validation. We won't generate new keys. Need it for ~2 hours per tester during the window.
kate: For onboarding, we need assessor emails to create ties to ephemeral roles. Send list + ID docs.
sam: Quick checklist I want agreed:
- ephemeral IAM role creation and expiry
- pre-signed S3 URLs for large evidence bundles
- audit export timeframe (retain 90 days minimum)
- KMS decrypt scoped to ARN and tag
- RBAC change ticket created for infra and DB teams
laura: I'll open SEC-1347 for RBAC and link to onboarding docs. Nate/Jess can you draft the ephemeral role policy? Minimal permissions.
jess: Draft snippet below — please review:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["s3:GetObject"], "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::acme-pt-evidence/*" },
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345" }
  ]
}
```
jess: Note: role will have a max session of 4 hours and will be revoked right after the window.
nate: For audit logs — we'll export CloudTrail and application access logs to the retention bucket. How long does the assessor need access to those exports?
kate: 7 days post-window should be enough for verification. We still need to keep raw logs per policy, but assessors only need the export snapshot.
laura: OK set 7 days for assessor S3 access, 90 days for internal retention. We'll create lifecycle rules for the assessor export prefix.
sam: Who's owning presigned URLs? I can generate but prefer ops ownership so creds don't leak. Ops-oncall will run a short script.
laura: @nate can you add the presigned generation script to the ticket with instructions for ops-oncall? Add text about single-use links.
nate: Will do. Example command to create one:
```
aws s3 presign s3://acme-pt-evidence/evidence-2026-03-05.tar.gz --expires-in 7200
```
laura: Security-bot will post when the ephemeral role is provisioned. Please react with :thumbsup: once you validate.
security-bot: Ephemeral role acme-pt-assessor-role created by jess. Expires: 2026-03-16T16:00:00Z. AuditID: audit-SEC-1347-01
sam: Nice. Also reminder — we need to snapshot DB credentials and rotate the read-only password after the window.
kate: Also request that application trace sampling is bumped to 100% during their window so they can correlate across traces.
laura: Good catch. Jess, can you add sampling change to the rollout plan and include rollback steps?
jess: Added: sampling -> 100% for 3 hours, rollback to 1% with runbook steps and dashboards to validate.
tom-redteam: Can we schedule a 30m pre-window sync tomorrow to confirm handoffs? timezone PST works for us.
laura: Scheduled. Invite sent to assessors and ops-oncall. :calendar:
sam: Final ask — please upload sanitized examples of what evidence looks like (redacted token formats) to the ticket so assessors know expected structure.
kate: Will do, uploading now.
laura: OK team — plan looks good. If no blockers by EOD I'll mark SEC-1347 ready for approvals and start onboarding.
sam: LGTM :thumbsup:
kate: :eyes:
laura: Closing thread, moving updates to SEC-1347. If anything changes ping here and I'll reopen the sync.
